env.name: PORT
env.description: HTTP port for the webui server (default 4700)

env.name: BIND
env.description: Bind host; non-loopback always requires a token (default 127.0.0.1)

env.name: TOKEN
env.description: Access token; omitted = host/CLI auto-generates a strong secret

env.name: TRUSTED_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated extra Host header allowlist (rebinding fence)
